title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) or their designee to execute Amendment No. 9 to the Lease Agreement with Downtown Properties, LLC (“Lessor”),…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0386, Agreement]
[FINANCE, BUDGET, AND AUDIT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (4-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) or their designee to execute Amendment No. 9 to the Lease Agreement with Downtown Properties, LLC (“Lessor”), for the Office of the Inspector General (“OIG”) located at 818 West 7th Street in Los Angeles (Attachment A - Location Map), extending the lease term for 65 months (5 years, 5 months), commencing August 1, 2027, at an initial rate of $39,274 per month with 3% annual escalations, for a total of $2,521,267.65 over the 65-month term.
summary: Extending the lease for Metro's Office of the Inspector General at 818 West 7th Street for 65 months at an initial rate of $39,274 per month with 3% annual escalations, totaling $2,521,267.65.
